content: NestJS JWT best practice: @nestjs/jwt + @nestjs/passport + passport-jwt strategy; short-lived access token (5-15 min) + separate long-lived refresh token with its own secret, refresh token hashed before storing in DB (never plaintext), token rotation on each refresh (issue new + invalidate old), refresh token delivered via httpOnly cookie scoped to /auth/refresh to block XSS. Don't mix session cookies with JWT.
